title: Claude Managed Agents: $0.08/hr — worth it vs Agent SDK?
description:
Anthropic just launched Managed Agents — a hosted runtime for AI agents. You pay standard API rates plus $0.08 per session-hour. Sandboxing, retries, and scaling are handled for you.

A 3-hour ticket-processing run? About 20 cents in runtime fees. The Agent SDK is free — but you host everything: scaling, retries, security, monitoring. Pick managed if shipping speed beats infrastructure control.
